name: TruthOffset
description: Draws, on an orbital-prediction layer, a line from each prediction to the ground-truth feature it predicts in another layer, coloured and labelled by the offset in metres.

components.name: Enabled
components.description: Compare each of this layer's predictions against the nearest/matching feature of another layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the offset lines sublayer is initially on.

components.name: Ground-truth Layers
components.description: A comma-separated array of names or UUIDs of the ground-truth layers to compare against. There is no layer picker: this is free text, and a renamed layer silently stops matching.

components.name: Match Property
components.description: The dot.notated feature property that must be equal in a prediction and its ground truth. Leave empty to match purely by nearest distance. Defaults to _crossrefTruthId, which the orbitalprediction layer type stamps.

components.name: Max Offset (m)
components.description: Pairs further apart than this are not drawn.

components.name: Worst Offset (m)
components.description: The offset at which a line is drawn fully red. Smaller offsets ramp toward green.

components.name: Label Offsets
components.description: Show the offset in metres as a tooltip on each line.

components.name: Line Weight
components.description: The thickness of the offset lines.
